detector.description: Alerts when there is a sudden change in latency for APM services.
detector.name: APM - Sudden change in service latency
detector.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.autodetect.apm import latency
latency.latency_deviations_from_norm_detector().publish('APM - Sudden change in service latency')

rules.description: Latency in service has increased by a specified amount
rules.detectLabel: APM - Sudden change in service latency
